candidates.B0: evaluate frozen Q2 M0-R1 plan; no optimization
candidates.M0-CORR: maximize mean profit on 120 R0 correlated training futures
candidates.M1-NET: maximize mean profit on the same 120 underlying futures under RSC
candidates.M2-RELROB: maximize 0.5 overall mean plus 0.5 worst relationship-world mean across R0/RS/RSC

comparison: 300 unseen underlying futures each evaluated under R0, RS and RSC, plus 18 named stresses

selection_thresholds.M1_over_M0: overall mean gain >=0.1%; worst-10% loss <=0.1%; RSC mean improves; management cost acceptable
selection_thresholds.M2_preferred: worst-world mean gain >=0.1% over best nonrobust candidate; overall mean loss <=0.5%
selection_thresholds.fallback: retain B0 if M0-CORR does not stably improve it
